title: King’s Edge Digital Experience
problemSolved: King’s Edge opportunities, participation records, developmental planning, evidence and recognition are not yet available through a coherent digital journey, leaving students dependent on fragmented systems, communications and prior knowledge.
whatChanges: Students encounter King’s Edge as the first substantive native product domain within the Digital Student Experience Hub, linking opportunity discovery, projects and participation, King’s Canvas, evidence and institutional digital recognition.

decisionLog.forum: Digital Student Experience Hub strategic alignment review
decisionLog.outcome: Confirmed that the King’s Edge replatform is not dependent on completion of 1.2 Student Systems and Data. The replatform should proceed against its agreed scope, shared application foundations and specific data/interface requirements. Student Systems and Data remains an important alignment, authoritative-data and integration dependency for the wider Hub and for later deeper journeys, but it does not gate the Edge replatform or the focused September 2027 first release.

decisionLog.forum: Digital Student Experience Hub strategic alignment review
decisionLog.outcome: Consolidated the King’s Edge base plan with the active delivery sequence. Edge is the fixed first substantive native product domain of the Digital Student Experience Hub: the existing service is replatformed first, richer Edge capabilities are developed on the shared foundations, and Edge increasingly reuses common Hub capabilities as the wider product matures.
